g.text: Open passage, leaving each room from the side you type. Tags mark up, down, in, out.
One-way: you can go this way but not back.
Door that opens freely (or with a button)
Locked: needs an item or a puzzle solved (blue line)
Opens or closes with story events (purple line)
Up and down exits leave and enter at a slant
Not an exit for you: a refusal, or a loop back to the same room
